request.prompt:
Top-down orthographic seamless tileable texture of red laterite earth of the Angolan highlands, dry compacted soil with small pebbles and a few dry grass tufts, evenly lit.

Absolutely no buildings, no people, no vehicles, no city, no perspective: only the material surface seen straight from above, filling the whole image.
